# Faiz Alam Faizi — Legal Bridge LLP®

Official website: https://iqxintelligencequotient.github.io/portfolio-faiz-alam-fazi/

## About
Firm leadership and coordinated legal and business advisory services in Lahore, Pakistan, serving clients across Pakistan and overseas. Consultation scope is subject to document review, conflict checks and written engagement.

## Services
Corporate advisory, technology law, intellectual property, cyber law, legal documentation, company formation, tax and accountancy.
